meta.title: Agenia — AI at work, under your control
meta.description: Agenia puts AI agents to work for your teams: the agent prepares, a person decides. Your data can stay on your own servers.

hero.title: AgenIA under control
hero.leadStrong: The agent prepares, your team decides.
hero.lead: Agenia puts AI to work in your company, without anyone losing control.
hero.reassure: No sign-up, no credit card · full access · 10 messages.

trail.question: “Check the server and tell me what's wrong.”

model.title: Local model
model.detail: The request never leaves your servers

consent.by: Decision made by Karim, not by the agent

capabilities.title: What the agent does for you

items.title: Talk to it, it answers.
items.text: Dictate your request into the microphone. The answer appears on screen and is read aloud, in your language.

items.title: It reads what you show it.
items.text: Attach an image, a Word document or a text file: it analyses them with you.

items.title: On your servers, or in the cloud.
items.text: You choose where the AI works: on your own servers, or with the cloud provider of your choice.

items.title: For the whole team.
items.text: Roles, quotas and instructions for each person: everyone gets what they need, nothing more.

demo.title: See the agent at work
demo.text: From question to answer, without leaving your screen.

promises.title: AI at work, without losing control.

items.title: Nothing is changed without your approval.
items.text: The agent reads and analyses freely. Before changing anything, it shows what will change and waits for your approval.

items.title: An off switch, always.
items.text: An administrator can switch an agent off at any time.

items.title: Your data stays with you.
items.text: Agenia can run entirely on your own servers. The cloud only if you choose it.

items.title: Everything can be traced.
items.text: Every action leaves a record. You know what was done, and when.

team.statement: An AI agent doesn't replace your team. It works for it.
points: The agent suggests, the person decides. Nothing is changed on their behalf without their approval.
Everyone keeps their role and their way of working. The tool fits the team you already have, not the other way round.
team.audience: For leaders who want to stay in control, and for the teams who do the work: consulting, development, support.

trial.title: Try it with your team
trial.text: 20 minutes of full access and 10 messages, no sign-up, no credit card.
trial.login: Already have an account? Sign in
